triggers: CREATE TRIGGER locked_historical_period BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON schedule_periods FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_locked_historical_schedule()

CREATE TRIGGER schedule_generator_snapshots_immutable BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE OR TRUNCATE ON schedule_generator_snapshots FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION reject_schedule_generator_snapshot_mutation()

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reject_schedule_generator_snapshot_mutation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
        BEGIN
            RAISE EXCEPTION 'Generator snapshots are immutable audit evidence';
        END;
        $function$
